blocks.quote: That objective is BERT's fill-in-the-blank loss, rearranged so that it defines a principled generative process. Sampling starts from a fully masked sequence, asks the bidirectional Transformer for a distribution at every masked position, and commits the predictions whose confidence clears a threshold. Easy, constrained tokens (punctuation, function words) lock in first; hard content words last. Because the model attends in both directions, it can also revise earlier tokens in light of later ones and fill in the middle of a document natively.
blocks.section: Diffusion Language Models: Denoising Instead of Decoding

blocks.quote: The appeal is throughput: one forward pass can commit many tokens, and the number of denoising steps is an explicit quality-versus-speed dial. **LLaDA** (2025), an 8-billion-parameter masked diffusion model trained from scratch, reported in-context learning and instruction following competitive with Llama 3 8B — the first evidence that the recipe holds at mainstream open-model scale (\cite[Nie et al., 2025]{nie2025llada}). Inception Labs' Mercury and Google DeepMind's experimental Gemini Diffusion followed in 2025, reporting sampling speeds in the thousands of tokens per second on H100-class hardware.
blocks.section: Diffusion Language Models: Denoising Instead of Decoding

blocks.quote: The costs are real. Bidirectional attention is incompatible with the standard KV cache, so every denoising step recomputes attention over the whole sequence; the speedup depends on keeping the step count well below the sequence length. Tokens committed in the same step are also treated as conditionally independent, so jointly dependent words can clash, which is why practical systems use confidence schedules and semi-autoregressive block decoding. Whether dLLMs reach full quality parity with autoregressive models at frontier scale remains open as of 2026.

Where Transformers Still Win
Despite the architectural menu, vanilla Transformers remain dominant in 2025 because:
The picture is changing fast: in 2025, Jamba, RecurrentGemma, RWKV-7, Striped Hyena, and several Mamba variants are deployed in production.
Open Questions

The next decade of architecture research is open. For a working practitioner today, **hybrid models (Jamba, Mamba-2-Transformer hybrids) are the safest choice** for long-context production deployments.
